MCP tool (cks-mcp) for resolving contradiction_detected tasks produced by ContradictionSweeper. Mechanical only — no LLM path. Called read-only (no contradiction_ids) it lists live contradictions; called with contradiction_ids it removes the alphabetically-first relation id among each contradiction's conflicting set.
